title: Password Sign-in Flow
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant IBM Verify

    User->>Frontend: Enter username & password
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/password/signin
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Client credentials grant
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Admin token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/authnmethods/password/verify
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Verify username/password
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Verification token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Exchange for access token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Access token
    Backend-->>Frontend: Access token
    Frontend->>Frontend: Store token & redirect to dashboard
